row.body: Rowan 2026-11-20: 'Resolve it, close it ... I will do nothing.' funding, domains-move, org-brand, social and oauth-apps leave the owner queue; each is a gate owner-<id> in doctrine/open-loops.json with surfaces tried, the default in effect, an optional reopen link and a probe. The /owner page shows nothing waiting. No agent submitted, signed in, accepted terms or moved a domain in the owner's name.
